summary: Sprint-3 Explainability + Sprint-4 Learning + Scanner Symbol Persistence testing completed. All backend APIs (16/16 tests passed) and frontend UI flows verified. Decision Cards display all required fields. Explainability Drawer shows full decision trace. Symbol Detail page (/user/symbol/:symbol) works with both navigation and direct URL. Scanner symbol persistence saves/restores selections. Admin Learning Panel shows strategy memory, guardrails, events, and recommendations.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test user and data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint-3/4 features complete. UserScannerPage displays decision cards with Symbol Detail buttons and 10s auto-refresh. ExplainabilityDrawer opens from scanner and symbol detail pages. Symbol selection persists via /api/user/scanner/symbol-selection. Admin Learning Panel shows strategy memory with rolling_quality_score, decay_adjusted_score, quality_degradation_flag, recommendations, guardrails, and events. All data-testid attributes in place.

decision_cards.auto_refresh: 10s label present on scanner, dashboard, and symbol detail
decision_cards.symbol_detail_button: Present on scanner decision cards, navigates to /user/symbol/:symbol

explainability_drawer.family_gates: Shows gate_status, threshold(L/S), gate_reason for each family
explainability_drawer.source_strategies: Shows strategy_id, family, direction, raw, normalized, weight, contribution, status
explainability_drawer.blocked_timeline: Shows timestamps, layer, reason_detail, state transitions

scanner_symbol_persistence.persistence_label: Sembol Kaydı: timestamp shown on page
scanner_symbol_persistence.behavior: Selection persisted and restored on page reload

admin_learning_panel.family_memory_table: Shows family, regime, sample, hit_rate, avg_return, volatility_success, conflict_success
admin_learning_panel.refresh_button: Learning memory refresh tamamlandı toast shown

api_tests_summary.GET /api/user/scanner/symbol-selection: 200 - returns id, user_id, scanner_id, symbol_source, symbol_selection_mode, selected_symbols, saved_at
api_tests_summary.GET /api/user/decision-cards: 200 - returns envelope with schema_version, engine_version, generated_at, items (with all decision card fields)
api_tests_summary.GET /api/user/explainability/{symbol}: 200 - returns full explainability with family_scores, source_strategies, blocked_reason_timeline, explanation_templates
api_tests_summary.GET /api/admin/learning/overview: 200 - returns guardrails, strategy_memory, family_memory, recommendations, events
